# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty at the start of the series  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders and has worn a full, soft brown beard since his youth. He rarely dresses up or wears a white collar unless he is leaving his home community.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is extremely shy, quiet, and terrified of women and strangers, with the exception of his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his silent demeanor, he possesses a deeply sympathetic and gentle nature, often indulging Anne Shirley when Marilla is strict. He prefers listening to others talk rather than conversing himself, and he holds quietly persistent opinions when his mind is set.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

- Farming and farm labor  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To provide a good home for Anne and support her ambitions  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lives at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla. Intending to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work, Matthew goes to the station only to find a young girl, Anne Shirley, whom he brings home out of compassion. Captivated by her spirit, he persuades Marilla to let her stay. Throughout her upbringing, Matthew remains Anne's gentlest champion, secretly buying her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for a school concert and encouraging her romantic nature. As Anne grows older, Matthew's heart condition worsens, preventing him from doing heavy labor. After learning that the Abbey Bank holding his life savings has failed, Matthew suffers a sudden, fatal heart attack and passes away at Green Gables, mourned deeply by his family and neighbors.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c28 P48](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0048), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Green Gables since the homestead was founded by his father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his later years  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
- Kept all his savings in the Abbey Bank  <sub>[v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034)</sub>
